reviews.comment: REQUEST CHANGES: (1) A18 locked-baseline check is loader-only — PUT /api/agents and MCP update_agent still accept an override that drops it, after which every load throws and user space is bricked until the file is hand-deleted; mirror the check in validateReferences('agents'). (2) The corrupt-secrets error embeds V8's JSON.parse message, which quotes the file content — leaks secret values into the 500 body + SSE; use a fixed message.
